---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Dapane problem
---

## Revision and runtime

Provide the Dapane release or commit, the command or binding, and your OS and
runtime version.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest synthetic input and command that reproduce the problem.

## Expected and observed results

Include the expected value or behaviour and the observed output or error.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through the repository's
[private reporting form](https://github.com/edithatogo/dapane/security/advisories/new).
Keep credentials, personal information and restricted workbooks out of issues.
